decision: Research target reduced from 3000–5000 to 500–800; existing evidence is preserved.

research.unit: distinct evidence-backed text-PV forms after deduplication and review

acceptance: Preserve breadth across motion, lettering, composition, expressive context and architecture counterexamples.
Do not count downloads, raw model observations, MMD-only scenes or parameter permutations as distinct text forms.
Prioritize deduplication, native-frame verification and category gaps in the existing corpus; acquire additional sources where gaps remain.
500 is the minimum reviewed form target; reaching it is not automatic architecture or commercial acceptance. Continue toward 800 where review and coverage warrant it.
Keep source references until linked original prototypes are implemented and reviewed.
supersedes: Earlier numeric research targets in work orders and plans; historical records remain historical.
